props.title: Describe your goal; your agent chooses the workflow
props.lead: The ShowAI plugin includes 8 skills that tell the agent how to connect, plan, design, build and review pages, how to make templates and components, and how to work alongside people who are editing. Describe what you need and your agent chooses the skills.

content.text: Skills are work instructions written to the Agent and distributed with the plug-in; the actual storage, component compilation and rendering are completed by the ShowAI runtime. All documentation operations for the Agent occur through the MCP, and the CLI is only used for startup, diagnostics, and scripting.
Four skills take a piece of work from idea to delivery; the other four connect to the content library, capture reusable resources, and edit the canvas alongside people.

cards.title: plan-presentation
cards.body: Sort out reader intentions, evidence needs and multi-level understanding paths. Produce mission brief, scope of evidence and passing conditions.

cards.title: design-presentation
cards.body: Turn planning into visuals and interactions: objects, relationships, layouts and states. Produce design drafts and resource selection.

cards.title: show-document
cards.body: Create, update, display and export reports, tutorial pages and mini-sites using existing templates. Produce a Page that can be edited.

cards.title: review-presentation
cards.body: Check whether the work supports the reader's tasks, locate areas that are difficult to understand, and revise as authorized. Produce addressable issues and revisions.

cards.title: use-showai
cards.body: Connect, find, and read content, query components and templates, and handle save conflicts.

cards.title: create-template
cards.body: Establish or extract reusable content structures from mature works and verify them in real applications.

cards.title: create-component
cards.body: Develop reusable React components when adjustments and combinations of existing components cannot be expressed.

cards.title: collaborate-canvas
cards.body: Work on a canvas alongside people who are still editing, handling multiple agent conversations, position references, iPad–Mac pairing and save status.

content.text: Which skills will be used in a request?

Simple questions are answered directly; ordinary modifications only do corresponding partial work; the complete work is advanced to each stage by show-document, and existing effective materials are directly reused. Toggle the process tab above to view the six stages of the complete work.

flows.label: Six stages of the complete work
flows.description: show-document advances these stages in sequence; each stage only reads the guide for the current template upon entry.

nodes.label: intent
nodes.subtitle: intention to understand
nodes.detail: Make it clear who the reader is, what task they are trying to accomplish, and distinguish between clear requirements, reasonable assumptions, and unknown conditions.

nodes.label: evidence
nodes.subtitle: Material handling
nodes.detail: Gather and check the required facts; template tables of contents and basic instructions are not a substitute for real research.

nodes.label: understanding
nodes.subtitle: Understanding the path · plan-presentation
nodes.detail: A multi-level understanding tree unfolds from the reader's starting point, with leaves containing definitions, relationships, processes, examples, or conditions. Preserve planning of complex works before production.

nodes.label: design
nodes.subtitle: Visual interaction · design-presentation
nodes.detail: Determine objects, relationships, layout, reading order and status, record them in storyboard format, and then select templates and components.

nodes.label: authoring
nodes.subtitle: Page production · show-document
nodes.detail: Apply a template or assemble from blank, read the complete source, modify and save with hash/revision.

nodes.label: review
nodes.subtitle: Review Delivery · review-presentation
nodes.detail: Verify the real content, screenshots and operations, save it after revision and deliver it with page_present.

Six types of Page templates are built-in during runtime, and the original blank, survey, comparison and briefing templates are still available:

cards.title: Concept and mechanism explanation
cards.body: Starting from specific problems, establish objects, relationships, mechanisms and applicable boundaries

cards.title: Plan comparison and decision-making
cards.body: Present comparable facts, gaps and trade-offs according to common standards

cards.title: Research and evidence reporting
cards.body: Organize facts, mechanisms, evidence, and limitations, distinguishing sources from inferences

cards.title: Operation and troubleshooting
cards.body: Real entrance, action, expected feedback and exception recovery

cards.title: Status and progress reports
cards.body: Status, changes, risks and next steps under deadline

cards.title: Exploration and data organization
cards.body: Organize data using categories, attributes and relationships to support overview and filtering

content.text: Templates are not automatic variable binding. It saves the structure and the guidelines for each stage, which are filled in by the Agent based on real materials; when materials are missing, the missing items are retained and the limitations of the conclusion are stated. There will be no filling prompts left in the completed work.

Source data verification, static screenshots, actual operations and reader readings provide different evidence, and the Agent will explain what was done respectively. The scope that has not been actually checked must be clearly told to you; without real people trying to read it, it does not claim to have proven the understanding effect.

attrs.title: After updating the plug-in, how to confirm that the skill has taken effect?

content.text: Plug-in installation, host refresh tool and session reading new instructions are three things that need to be checked separately:
Open a new session to see the actual list of available skills.
, confirm MCP capabilities; complete work process requirements
Check the template directory to see if it is a new version.
Installing the plug-in will not upgrade the ShowAI software. When capabilities are lost, the software needs to be updated and the runtime re-registered.
